posts.author: Unknowninvestor
posts.text: If you read through the explanations of the 6.87 L crore advisory mandate a large part of it comes from the PFRDA on equity and fixed income where the fees is < 10 bps. the actual PMS / AIF’s with a fees of 80-90 bps will be less than 50K crores (optimistic) . Those are difficult structures to scale to large AUM as they are not SIP led which see inflow automatically once Habit forms

posts.author: newone
posts.text: The PMS AUM for Q2 shows as 6869 bn (6,86,900 crores) vs 122 bn in Q1 (1,22,000 crores). Could it be a typo? Source : Q1 & Q2 investor presentations
